# Circular to independent assessors

Dear Assessor,

This circular explains the revised format for estimates submitted after 1 December 2026. It contains no instruction concerning a particular dispute. Please continue using the existing form until that date, as estimates received earlier will be assessed under the current administrative procedure.

The heading **Person responsible** requests a role, such as Surveyor or Technical Reviewer. The heading **Organisation type** requests a description, such as partnership or sole trader. Neither heading requires a named individual or business in the preliminary estimate. The terms Client, Contractor, Company and Representative retain their defined meanings in the standard conditions.

Do not insert a date of birth, passport number, telephone number, email address, tax identifier or bank account in the estimate. Those labels appear in the guidance only to explain which information belongs in a later confidential instruction. An empty field should remain empty rather than being completed with sample digits.

The Ministry of Justice publishes general procedural information, while the County Court determines any application in a live dispute. Article 6, section 4.2 and schedule 3 of the standard conditions continue to apply. Briefing seminars on the new format will be held in London and Cardiff in January.

The revised fee illustration is GBP 950 plus 20 percent tax. It is an example of cost calculation and creates no payment obligation.

Yours faithfully,

The Administrative Team
